motivation: The source-bound SWAP 4.3.1 KSATEXM law is continuous but has a conductivity-derivative seam at h=-2 cm. The rejected uniform-u grid places this seam inside a table cell. R1 aligns the exact source-defined seam with a table node without increasing node count or memory.

representation.interpolation: bilinear in log mobility with float64 arithmetic inside one piecewise-axis cell

locator.exact_seam_rule: u==u_seam maps exactly to x=18 and therefore never interpolates across the constitutive seam

characterization.probe_set: reuse the frozen C2A development characterization probes because no holdout has been accessed

exit_rule.pass_all_six: freeze R1 and create a fresh 36-material KSATEXM holdout with new probes before any C2A catalog qualification claim
exit_rule.any_fail: reject R1 fail-closed and diagnose whether additional wet-end representation structure is required; do not tune on a future holdout

scope_guard: No h>-1 cm, no non-zero H_ENPR, no saturation switching, no heterogeneous profiles, no timestep qualification, no bottom boundary, no groundwater, no MultiSWAP production claim, no J1 response-tangent admission and no FullRichards equivalence.
